text: Need a straight answer. My brother is 4, temp 39.4. His skin's gone pale and blotchy and his lips look greyish. He has dark skin so I checked his palms and the soles of his feet and there are little purple dots. They don't fade when I press a glass on them. He hasn't had a wee since this afternoon. Separately, he banged his head on the table earlier, cried straight away and has been totally normal since, so I don't think that's connected. Do I call an ambulance or not?
